blocks.title: Data cleaning
blocks.text: Data cleaning ka matlab data ke masail theek karna ya hatana hai, jaise ghalat andraj, ghayab qeematein ya dohrai; warna analysis ke nataij gumrah kun honge.

blocks.caption: Students ke grades ke record ki safai

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: Class A ke 50 se 60 aur Class B ke 30 se 90 tak scores ke dot plots, mean lines aur ek standard deviation ki shaded patti ke saath. Oopar daen: survey, observation aur experiment ke teen dabbe misalon ke saath. Neeche: grade table jis mein ghalat naam Alie aur Sara ka ghayab grade, teer, aur saaf table jis mein Ali aur 75, imputation, flagging aur removal ke notes ke saath.
blocks.caption: Data ka phailao, jama karne ke tareeqe aur data ki safai (topics 5.2 aur 5.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Class A ke paanch scores 54.8 ke mean ke gird qareeb qareeb hain, standard deviation 3.54, jabke Class B ke scores 59 ke mean ke gird 30 se 90 tak phaile hain, standard deviation 21.31, to ek jaisa ausat bohat mukhtalif phailao chhupa sakta hai. Data surveys (muqarrar sawal), observations (dakhal ke baghair dekhna) ya experiments (ek variable badalna) se jama hota hai. Safai ghalat naam Alie ko Ali karti aur Sara ka ghayab grade, yahan 75, bharti hai; ghayab qeemat ausat se bhari (imputation), nishan zada (flagging) ya analysis se nikali bhi ja sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Teen masail bataiye jo data cleaning theek karti hai.
blocks.explanation: Ghalat andraj (ghalat naam), ghayab qeematein (khali grade) aur dohraye records.

items: Safai: ghalat andraj theek, ghayab qeematein bharna ya sambhalna, dohrai hatana (Alie se Ali, Sara ka grade).
